title.narrative: Output 7.5. Increased capacity of Member States to develop fair and effective labour migration frameworks, institutions and services to protect migrant workers

description.narrative: A five-year regional strategic plan for the Confederation of IGAD Employers (CIE) including labour migration issues was developed and adopted in 2023. A similar Plan for the Horn of Africa Confederation of Trade unions (HACTU) including labour migration issues was developed and adopted in 2023. The strategic plans articulate and define the priority areas of cooperation with IGAD and other organizations to advance decent work, social justice, and regional integration. These developments with CIE and HACTU in partnership with IGAD Secretariat are important milestones for instituting a functioning social dialogue and tripartism at regional level. The Programme for Implementation of the Djibouti Declaration on Labour, Employment and Labour migration was endorsed on 2 March 2023. The Djibouti Declaration on Labour, Employment and Labour Migration is a key policy instrument to comprehensively address the challenges of labour, employment, and labour migration in the IGAD Region. The Programme will assist implementation of policies around Ratification and Domestication of International Labour Standards, Promotion of Rights of Migrant Workers, Social Dialogue, Extending Social Protection for All, and Promoting Gender Equity and Equality among others. With the support of the EU, ILO organized a regional capacity building and experience sharing workshop for social partners in the IGAD region in Arusha, Tanzania. The workshop enabled social partners in the IGAD region to learn from the experiences of their counterparts in the East Africa region including East Africa Trade Union Confederation (EATUC) and East African Employers Origination (EAEO). Subsequently, the ILO supported CIE and HACTU to establish their respective organizations, develop necessary documents including their bylaws as well as hold their regular board meetings and develop their strategic plans through consultative process. ILO in close collaboration with IGAD Secretariat and support of the European Union organized the second Ministerial Conference of Ministers of Labour and Employment of IGAD Member States on 2 March 2023 in Addis Ababa to adopt the Programme for Implementation. ILO provided substantive, logistical and financial support to this Conference. Two expert meetings were organized prior to the ministerial conference which gave space for broader consultation on the Programme for Implementation. The meetings were attended by experts from the Ministry of Labour, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and other line Ministries involved in labour market and labour migration issues.
